title: SimplyPrint Failure Rate by Printer Model
dataSources: Print jobs (`octoprint:job`), printer firmware telemetry (`printer:telemetry`), filament spools (`filament:spool`), CNC/laser jobs (`cnc:job`), workshop air (`workshop:air`), cordless tool batteries (`tool:battery`).
app: OctoPrint / Klipper (Moonraker) print servers, printer firmware telemetry, filament spool tracking, CNC/laser job logs, and workshop air/tool sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=simplyprint:job
stats avg(success_flag) as success_rate by printer_name
description: Ranks SimplyPrint printers by job success rate.
value: Surfacing simplyprint failure rate by printer model helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant making, 3d printing & workshop export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It produces when simplyprint failure rate by printer model matters for your routine.
